title: Lake Billy Chinook — weather inside the fish
note: Raster concept with simplified Lake Billy Chinook-inspired cutout. Weather and lighting change inside a consistent fish silhouette.
prompt:
Edit the attached OREGON FISH FORECAST four-state logo concept board to correct the creative direction.

USER'S KEY CORRECTION: "the changing skies ... inside the fish ... we see the weather or vibe change inside the fish." The fish must act as a window onto changing weather. Remove EVERY weather symbol currently floating above the fish. The atmosphere, lighting colors, clouds, rain and snow belong ENTIRELY WITHIN the fish silhouette. Do not merely move a little weather badge onto the fish. Show four distinct little outdoor scenes INSIDE the same recognizable fish.

REFERENCES:
1. The four-state Lake Billy Chinook weather board is the edit target. Preserve its improved branching lake cutout.
2. The C · Confluence Trout board is supporting brand reference only.

LOCKED GEOMETRY: All four versions must use the SAME right-facing trout outline, same tail/fins/head/eye position, same blue outer boundary, and the SAME connected cream negative-space silhouette inspired by Lake Billy Chinook. Preserve its long west arm, two southern arms separated by green land, and short north connection. Keep every lake branch and its widths consistent. Do not replace it with a generic Y. The lake is a flat cream cutout, not a perspective river illustration; do not bend it to fit a landscape. Keep it crisp and clearly legible against every interior scene.

INTERIOR WEATHER / MOOD: Treat the upper portion of the fish, including the large dorsal fin, as sky; broad landforms below stay evergreen with restrained changes in light. All scene elements are clipped cleanly within the fish boundary. Use bold, simple, flat illustrated shapes, with only a few purposeful details. Keep a continuous dark Oregon-blue edge so the silhouette is recognizable when the sky is pale. Fish eye stays a small contrasting circular eye at its original position, separate from any sun.
Top left SUNNY: bright sky blue, a small warm gold sun wholly inside the upper body/dorsal area, a soft broad warm-gold light band, richly lit evergreen hills. Feels like a clear, inviting day.
Top right CLOUDY: cool muted blue sky, two substantial pale cloud bands moving across the upper interior, subdued green landforms. Feels calm and overcast.
Bottom left RAINY: deep slate-blue sky, one broad low cloud shape, a few short diagonal pale rain strokes entirely inside the body; darker evergreen land. Feels rainy and atmospheric.
Bottom right SNOWY: pale icy-blue sky, a few simple small snow marks inside the upper body, restrained white caps on the evergreen landforms. Preserve enough blue/green contrast so snow never obscures, freezes or changes the cream lake outline.

CONSISTENCY: Same silhouette, geographic cutout, layout, scale and typography across all four; weather and interior color mood visibly change. Weather scenery must have substance, not be a generic cloud icon pasted on solid green. No scenery or symbols outside the fish. No photorealism, textures, gradients, complex pine forests, microscopic details or 3D effects. This remains an illustrated brand mark.

PRESENTATION: Square 2048x2048 concept board on warm paper #F5F2E9. Clean 2x2 comparison, fine subtle separators, generous whitespace. Header 'CONFLUENCE / CHANGING SKIES', smaller subtitle 'Lake Billy Chinook'. Each panel shows one large fish with internal weather scene, exact two-line blue wordmark 'OREGON' / 'FISH FORECAST', and its readable state label SUNNY / CLOUDY / RAINY / SNOWY. Preserve the restrained blue/evergreen/gold brand identity while allowing the specified atmospheric sky colors. No floating weather icons, no badges, no separate weather illustrations. Make the user's corrected direction unmistakable.
